title: 再生煞車電力回收
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討機械動能、回生轉矩與儲能接受能力，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore kinetic energy, regenerative torque and storage acceptance, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。這是離線功率與控制課，不是道路車輛煞車改裝指南；制動安全與功能安全需獨立專業驗證。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. This is offline power/control education, not a road-vehicle braking modification guide; braking and functional safety need independent professional validation.

stages.title: 動能與負載
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成動能與負載；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete kinetic energy and load through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 核算平移動能：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Audit translational energy: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解核算平移動能，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand audit translational energy through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 重算本課 62.5 Wh，再比較由 10 m/s 降至零的 20.83 Wh。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute 62.5 Wh and compare with 20.83 Wh for slowing from 10 m/s to zero. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 重算本課 62.5 Wh，再比較由 10 m/s 降至零的 20.83 Wh。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Recompute 62.5 Wh and compare with 20.83 Wh for slowing from 10 m/s to zero. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「核算平移動能」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把機械動能、回生轉矩與儲能接受能力的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If audit translational energy disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of kinetic energy, regenerative torque and storage acceptance behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「核算平移動能」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for audit translational energy, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 核算平移動能：原理
knowledge.text: 可回收能量由速度平方差決定，不是速度差本身。
knowledge.textEn: Recoverable kinetic energy follows the difference of squared speeds, not speed difference alone.

knowledge.title: 核算平移動能：證據
knowledge.text: 重算本課 62.5 Wh，再比較由 10 m/s 降至零的 20.83 Wh。
knowledge.textEn: Recompute 62.5 Wh and compare with 20.83 Wh for slowing from 10 m/s to zero.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：1,500 kg 車輛由 20 m/s 降至 10 m/s，動能差 0.5m(v₁²−v₂²)=225 kJ=62.5 Wh；若機電回收效率 70%，最多回收 43.75 Wh，尚需扣除其他限制造成的損失。 這是離線功率與控制課，不是道路車輛煞車改裝指南；制動安全與功能安全需獨立專業驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 1,500 kg vehicle slowing from 20 to 10 m/s loses 0.5m(v₁²−v₂²)=225 kJ=62.5 Wh. At 70% recovery efficiency, at most 43.75 Wh is recovered before other limits. This is offline power/control education, not a road-vehicle braking modification guide; braking and functional safety need independent professional validation.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「再生煞車電力回收」的「核算平移動能：建立模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「微電網：守住晚高峰」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Audit translational energy: build the model” in “Regenerative-braking energy recovery”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Microgrid: Protect the Evening Reserve” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
